cmd_crew_voice_fail_build: Error of atlas crew voice install when cmake failed. {target} is the ssh target, {reason} the last lines of the build.
cmd_crew_voice_fail_checksum: Error of atlas crew voice install when sha256sum refused a download. {what} names the file, {target} the ssh target, {reason} the checksum tool's words.
cmd_crew_voice_fail_dir: Error of atlas crew voice install. {target} is the ssh target, {reason} the server's own words.
cmd_crew_voice_fail_download: Error of atlas crew voice install. {what} names the file (whisper.cpp 1.9.5, the small model), {target} the ssh target, {reason} the server's own words.
cmd_crew_voice_no_apt: Error of atlas crew voice install on a server without apt-get. {target} is the ssh target, {tools} the missing command names, comma separated; both shown as is.
cmd_crew_voice_ready: Last line of atlas crew voice install. {target} is the ssh target.
cmd_crew_voice_status_ready: Line of atlas crew voice status when nothing is missing. {target} is the ssh target, {version} the whisper.cpp version.
cmd_crew_voice_step_apt: Progress line of atlas crew voice install before the single root command (apt-get install). {count} is how many packages are missing.
cmd_crew_voice_step_build: Progress line of atlas crew voice install while cmake builds whisper.cpp on the server.
cmd_crew_voice_step_built: Progress line of atlas crew voice install when the pinned binary is already on the server. {version} is the whisper.cpp version.
cmd_crew_voice_step_model: Progress line of atlas crew voice install: downloading the pinned model and verifying its sha256. {model} is small or base.
cmd_crew_voice_step_model_present: Progress line of atlas crew voice install when the model file is there with the right checksum. {model} is small or base.
cmd_crew_voice_step_source: Progress line of atlas crew voice install: downloading the pinned source and verifying its sha256. {version} is the version.
cmd_crew_voice_step_tools: Progress line of atlas crew voice install: looking for the build tools and ffmpeg on the server.
cmd_crew_voice_unknown_model: Error of atlas crew voice install when the model is not one of the pinned ones. {model} is what was typed; small and base are literal.
